worked_solution:
The union of a family of indexed sets is the set containing all elements belonging to *at least one* set in the indexed family:

$$
{⋃}_{i\in I}{A}_{i}={x\in U\,:\,x\in {A}_{i}\,\,\text{for at least one }{A}_{i},\,\,i\in I}
$$

where $U$ is a universal set.

Therefore, in our case, we have 

$$
\begin{aligned}{⋃}_{i\in I}{S}_{i} & ={S}_{5}\cup {S}_{6}\cup {S}_{7} \\  & =[5,6)\,\cup \,[6,7)\,\cup \,[7,8) \\  & =[5,8).\end{aligned}
$$
